given_name.doc: Legal given name. Mortal humans require this plus surname (roster lint); civic title may hide it in prose.

surname.doc: Family name. Required on mortal-human rows (lint); lore or pool-stamped.

title.doc: Civic title that hides given_name in prose (Sheriff, Deputy, Agent, Doctor).

public_mononym.doc: True = player prose uses given_name only (Ash); surname still on file.

favorite_bar.doc: Hangout catalog id (harvelles, hometown) -- not a stay_home leash.

appearance.doc: Look slots from appearance catalog (all CORE_SLOTS when set).

coins.doc: Legacy wallet field; prefer dollars + cents.

workplace.doc: Shift / vendor room key (vendors require this on npc.vendor).

shift_start.doc: Shift start hour 0-23 (omit for always-on duty).

shift_end.doc: Shift end hour 0-23 (omit for always-on duty).

family.doc: Household / family tag for social hooks.

favorite_job.doc: Preferred jobs.json id when picking gig work.

stats.doc: Primary stat overrides: POW, VIT, FOC, FIN, RES, PRE -> number.

kit.doc: Appearance kit override (mortal only at engine tier).

essential.doc: True = cannot die / despawn (mentors, plane agents).

stay_home.doc: True = never leave home for leisure (mission_giver also pins).

event_sticky.doc: True = Cadence will not walk them; offline snap to home_room_key (bandaid event pin).

spar_only.doc: True = sparring partner only; townsfolk default lethal-capable.

role.doc: Optional staff role tag (reserved for job-role hooks).

intro_lines.doc: First-meet hail lines (mission intro; usually on giver catalog).
